identity.consequence: Z_1loop = prod_{n>=2} |R(n,sigma_n)|^{-2} -- an INFINITE PRODUCT of Ruelle zeta values

identity.statement: sigma_k one-dimensional => R(k,sigma_k) = prod_{[gamma] prime} (1 - q_gamma^k), q = e^{-l+i theta} = the GMY nome, EXACTLY
